source.description:
Research finding: 'Ask HN: How are you keeping AI coding agents from burning money?' was a top discussion topic — cost control is a major concern for agent users.

**Action items:**
1. Add token counting to specialists CLI (--track-costs flag)
2. Log cost per run to ~/.xtrm/costs.json with: specialist, bead, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, estimated_cost
3. Show cost summary in specialists result output
4. Add alert threshold (--alert-over=$5.00)
5. Display cumulative costs in bd show <id> for claimed issues

**Example output:**
```
specialists run bug-hunt --bead bd-123 --track-costs
# ... run completes ...
# Cost: $0.42 (gemini-flash) — 847K tokens (412K in, 435K out)
```

**Why this matters:** Users need visibility into agent operating costs, especially for long-running specialist jobs.

**Source:** last30days research on AI coding agents (HN discussion)
source.notes: Release triage 2026-05-04: valuable roadmap work, but not required for the next patch release. Defer until after release-critical bugfix/docs/packaging items land.
source.title: Add token/cost tracking per specialist run
